# Special Effects Unlimited

> > Hollywood's premier special effects equipment rental and custom fabrication company serving the film and production industry with 24/7 service.

Based in the heart of Hollywood's production corridor (Burbank, Culver City, Universal City), Special Effects Unlimited provides comprehensive special effects solutions including weather effects, motion control equipment, and custom fabrication services for professional film and television productions.

## Key Topics

- Weather Effects Equipment
- Wind Machines & Fans
- Ritter Fan
- Big Ass Fan
- RE V Fan & RE III Fan
- Motion Effects (Turntables & Treadmills)
- Hollywood Film Production
- Equipment Rental Services
- Custom Fabrication
- 24/7 Production Support
- Film Industry Supplies
- Special Effects Rentals
- Hollywood Production Studios
